content: Duwen Aramas Samin
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Koasoanediong mehn Israel kan re en kesehsang nan kahnimpwalo koaros me soumwahu tokutok oh me nahn kin pwilisang ni paliwere oh koaros me saminkilahr ar sairada aramas mehla.
Kadarala soangen aramas me samin ong kaudok pwukat koaros, pwe re dehr kasaminehla kahnimpwalo, wasa me I kin koukousoan ie rehn nei aramas akan.”
Mehn Israel ko eri kapwaiada oh keseirailsang nan kahnimpwalo.
Kapwungala Sapwung me Wiawihong emen
KAUN-O ketikihong Moses
kaweid pwukat pwe en padahkihong mehn Israel ko. Ma aramas emen pahn soaloalopwoatohng KAUN-O oh wiahda mehkot sapwung ong emen,
e pahn sakarkihda eh sapwungo oh kapwungala ni unsek, patehng persent 20, ong aramas me e wiahiong sapwungo.

Ahpw ma aramaso melahr oh sohte kiseh me karanih me pweipweio kak kohieng, e pahn kohieng KAUN-O pwe en uhd kohieng samworo. Pweipwei wet pahn patehng meirong en sihpw wol me samworo kin wia pwehn kamwakelehda aramas dipan meno.
Pil duwehte kisakis kesempwal koaros me mehn Israel kin meirongkihong KAUN-O kin uhd kohieng pweisen samworo men me re kin kihong meirongo.
Emenemen samworo pahn tungoalenkihla meirong kan me kin kohieng.
Wiepen Lih me eh Pwoud Lemelemehkohng
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses

en padakihong mehn Israel ko kaweid pwukat. Ma ohl emen pahn lemelemehkohng eh pwoud me dene e kin pitipitih oh kasaminehkilahr pein ih pwehki eh kapwaiada nsenen pwopwoud ong emen ohl tohrohr. Ahpw e sohte dehdehiong ohlo pwehki ele liho eh kin karkaririh—sohte sounkadehde, oh sohte me diarada eh wiewia tiahko. De ohl emen kak lemelemehkohng eh pwoud, mehnda ma liho sohte wia mehkot sapwung.

Eri, nan ire pwukat koaros ohlo pahn kahrelahng eh pwoud rehn samworo. E pil pahn wa kohla mehn meirong me koasoandier, paun riau en pilawa parli, ahpw e sohte pahn doaloahki lehn olip de warpwohmwau, pwehki eh wia meirong en ohl lemelemehk men, me men diarada dahme mehlel.
Samworo pahn kahrehla lih pwehn kesihnenda mwohn pei sarawio.
E pahn wudekihong pihl sarawi nan pwohl ehu oh ale pwehl sang nan taten Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale oh kihong nan pihlo.
Mwuri, e pahn sapwadpeseng pitenmoangen liho oh kihdiong nan pehn liho pilawa amas mehn meirong. Samworo ahpw pahn kolada pwohl me audauhdki pihl katiko mehn keriahla aramas.
Samworo ahpw pahn ndahng liho en pwungki kahula wet me samworo pahn wia, “Ma ke sohte wia dipen kamwahl, ke sohte pahn ale keria sang nan pihl wet.
Ahpw ma ke wiadahr dipen kamwahl,
KAUN-O en ketin wiahkihla edomwen mehn keria ieu rehn kisehmw kan. En ketin kupwurehda pwe omw wasa sarawien en wetikitikla oh kapehdomwen en mpwospeseng.
Pihl wet en kohlong nan kapehdomwen oh kamwpwosepeseng oh kanurpene omw wasa sarawien.” Liho ahpw pahn sapeng, nda, “Ei, I pwungki, kupwur en KAUN-O en pweida.”
Samworo ahpw pahn ntingihedi keria wet oh widensang ntingo nan pwohl en pihl katiko.
Mwohn eh pahn kihong liho en nim pihlo me pahn kak en kahrehiong weirek laud,
samworo pahn ale meirong en pilawa me mi nan pehn liho, oh kolada pwehn kasarawihong KAUN-O oh patohwandiong pohn pei sarawio.
E ahpw pahn ale ehu oaroahr en pilawao nin duwen kilel en meirong oh isikala pohn pei sarawio. Mwuhr e pahn kihong liho en nim pihlo.
Ma e wiahda dihp ong emen ohl tohrohr, pihlo pahn kahrehiong eh pahn weirek laud; kapehde pahn mpwospeseng oh eh wasa sarawio pahn nurpene. Ede pahn wiahla mehn keria rehn kiseh kan.
Ahpw ma e sohte dipada, e sohte pahn ale mehkot suwed oh e pahn kak neitik.
Ih duwen kosonned ong ohl akan me kin luwak oh lemelemehk me ar pwoud kan kin kamwahl. Liho pahn kesihnenda mwohn pei sarawio, samworo ahpw pahn wia sarawi wet.
Ohlo pahn saledeksang dihp, ahpw ma liho dipada, e pahn lokolongki dipeo.
